market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a fringe political activist (founder of MBL) with no significant electoral base. To finish second in the Brazilian presidential first round, he would need to outperform major opposition candidates and established figures, which is virtually impossible. The market's ~6.2% implied chance is a massive overestimate; the true likelihood is below 1%.
evidence_points: Renan Santos is a minor activist, not a national political heavyweight
Second place in Brazilian presidential elections is consistently won by major party candidates with broad coalitions
